question.text:
Which of the following is a positive overlap that leads to bonding?

(I)

(II)

(III)

(IV)

solution.text:
Concept: Overlapping of only same phase creates bonding.
(I) There is no case of bonding as a positive phase cannot simultaneously make bond with other orbital's positive as well as negative phase
(II) This creates bonding of p and d orbital.
(III) This creates bonding of two 'p' orbitals.
(IV) This is the case of anti-bonding of two 'd' orbitals.
